stem.text: A shelf XY is $0.40\,\text{m}$ long and is attached to a wall at end X.
It is kept horizontal by a wire attached to Y and to the wall, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal shelf XY attached to a wall at X, held by a wire from Y to the wall; the wire tension is labelled 15 N at 30°, the shelf length is labelled 0.40 m, and the wall, shelf and wire are labelled.

stem.text: The tension force in the wire is $15\,\text{N}$ at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.
What is the moment of this force about point X?
